description:
[Merchant] Delete an active deep link for a product. Once deleted, the deep link URL will no longer redirect to the payware mobile app.

**Use Cases:**
- Remove expired product links
- Clean up after product removal
- Security cleanup for discontinued products

**Important Notes:**
- Deep links are only supported in production environment
- Once deleted, the link cannot be recovered - you'll need to create a new one
- This operation is irreversible

partnerId.description: Partner ID from payware dashboard. Uses PAYWARE_PARTNER_ID env var as default.

privateKey.description: RSA private key for JWT token creation. Uses environment-specific private key as default.

name: payware_deep_links_delete_product_link
